questions.scenario: Your school is hosting a massive food festival. What job do you immediately volunteer for?

options.text: Managing the cash counter and calculating the profits.
Making sure the raw materials (plates, ice, food) arrive at every stall exactly on time.
Standing outside and shouting loudly to attract students to your stall.
Coming up with the main theme of the festival and leading the whole committee.

questions.scenario: You want to buy a new expensive pair of shoes, but your budget is tight. What is your strategy?

options.text: I track the prices online for weeks and wait for the biggest discount day.
I search 10 different websites to find the seller offering the fastest delivery.
I go to a local shop and bargain hard with the shopkeeper to lower the price.
I try to figure out a side-hustle (like selling old games) to quickly earn the extra money.

questions.scenario: You are organizing a surprise birthday party for your best friend. What stresses you out the most?

options.text: If we end up spending way more money than we planned.
If the cake delivery gets delayed and ruins the timing.
If the guests don't interact and the party gets boring.
If someone else tries to take control and changes my grand plan.

questions.scenario: You open a delivery app (like Blinkit or Swiggy). What do you secretly find fascinating?

options.text: Watching how the prices of items change depending on demand.
Watching the little GPS icon of the delivery rider moving through traffic.
Looking at the beautiful food photos that make me want to order immediately.
Wondering how the app founders built such a massive, working company.

questions.scenario: When you have an argument with a friend, how do you usually win?

options.text: I bring up cold, hard facts and old messages to prove I am right.
I patiently explain the step-by-step logic of where they went wrong.
I talk smoothly, joke a bit, and change their mood until they agree.
I just firmly state my point and refuse to back down.

questions.scenario: You are playing a strategy video game. What is your favorite part?

options.text: Looking at my stats, points, and resource numbers growing.
Building the roads, transport lines, and managing the inventory.
Chatting with other players and convincing them to ally with me.
Conquering new areas and expanding my empire as fast as possible.

questions.scenario: Your teacher gives the class a huge, boring assignment. What do you do?

options.text: Calculate exactly how many marks it's worth to decide if I should do it.
Make a strict timetable: 2 pages today, 2 pages tomorrow.
Try to talk the teacher into giving us a completely different, fun assignment.
Gather 3 smart friends, divide the work, and get it done fast as a team.

questions.scenario: What is the worst feeling for you?

options.text: Losing money on a bad purchase.
Being late or someone else making me wait.
Being ignored or awkward silences in a group.
Having to follow someone else's silly rules.

questions.scenario: If you could instantly download a new skill into your brain, what would it be?

options.text: The ability to perfectly predict the stock market.
The ability to instantly map and memorize any city's roads.
The ability to instantly make anyone like and trust me.
The ability to instantly spot a million-dollar business idea.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube video are you most likely to watch at night?

options.text: A video explaining a massive financial scam or stock market crash.
A documentary on how Amazon delivers millions of packages in a day.
A podcast where confident people talk about psychology and persuasion.
An interview with a young billionaire who started from nothing.

Agri_Trader_Analyst.title: Agri-Trader / Commodity Analyst
Agri_Trader_Analyst.primary_match_text: You are extremely analytical and money-smart. You love tracking numbers, finding patterns, and making calculated decisions based on facts.
Agri_Trader_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Monitoring global crop prices, predicting market shortages, and trading massive amounts of agricultural commodities (like wheat or sugar) on the stock exchange.
Agri_Trader_Analyst.alternative_match_text: Because you are great with numbers and predicting trends, analyzing market prices for agricultural goods is a strong backup plan.
Agri_Trader_Analyst.roadmap: Take Commerce (with Math) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Com, Economics degree, or BBA in Agribusiness, followed by studying financial markets.

Supply_Chain_Manager.title: Supply Chain & Logistics Manager
Supply_Chain_Manager.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate organizer. You love structure, hate delays, and have a brain that naturally figures out the fastest and most efficient way to get things done.
Supply_Chain_Manager.day_in_the_life: Managing massive warehouses, coordinating truck fleets, and ensuring that fresh produce moves from the farm to city supermarkets before it spoils.
Supply_Chain_Manager.alternative_match_text: Since you are highly organized and hate delays, managing the complex supply chains of food delivery is a perfect alternative for you.
Supply_Chain_Manager.roadmap: Take Commerce or Science in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in Supply Chain Management or a B.Sc in Agribusiness.

Agri_Sales_Executive.title: Agri-Marketing & Sales Executive
Agri_Sales_Executive.primary_match_text: You are a natural talker. You understand people's psychology, know how to negotiate, and can smoothly convince anyone to agree with you.
Agri_Sales_Executive.day_in_the_life: Traveling to different regions, meeting large-scale farmers to pitch new farming equipment, or convincing supermarket chains to buy your company's organic products.
Agri_Sales_Executive.alternative_match_text: If you want a job where you are always meeting new people and using your charm, marketing agricultural products is a highly lucrative option.
Agri_Sales_Executive.roadmap: Any stream works in 11th/12th (Commerce preferred). Pursue a BBA in Marketing or Agribusiness Management.

Agri_Startup_Founder.title: Agri-Business Entrepreneur
Agri_Startup_Founder.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader and risk-taker. You hate following other people's rules, love taking charge of situations, and want to build something huge from scratch.
Agri_Startup_Founder.day_in_the_life: Pitching your new food-delivery or smart-farming app to investors, hiring a team, and working long hours to build your own empire.
Agri_Startup_Founder.alternative_match_text: With your leadership skills and independent mindset, starting your own business in the agriculture sector is a great path if you don't want a traditional job.
Agri_Startup_Founder.roadmap: Take Commerce or Science in 11th/12th. Focus on a BBA, B.Tech, or B.Sc in Agribusiness, and start learning about startup funding and business models early.
